steps.description: Review project requirements and design specifications.
Set up development environment (e.g., IDE, tools).
Implement code according to the design specifications.
Write unit tests for newly implemented features.
Deploy code changes to staging environment.
Monitor application performance and user feedback.
Identify bugs or errors reported by users or automated testing.
Locate the source of the bug within the codebase.
Debug the issue and fix the code accordingly.
Re-test the affected functionality to ensure correctness.
Review existing documentation for accuracy and completeness.
Create or update relevant sections of the documentation.
Ensure all technical terms and concepts are explained clearly.
Test the updated documentation to confirm its usability.
Publish the updated documentation to the website or repository.
Analyze current application performance metrics.
Identify areas where performance can be improved.
Research and implement optimization techniques.
Monitor the impact of optimizations over time.
Adjust strategies if necessary based on ongoing performance data.
Attend team meetings and participate actively.
Respond promptly to emails and messages related to the project.
Contribute to discussions and provide constructive feedback.
Stay informed about project progress through regular updates.
Resolve conflicts and maintain a positive work environment.
